verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent cards are order intents that give an agent a fixed allowance with an amount and expiration, enforced through Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay. The agent gets a one-time card number and never sees the real one, the merchant is fixed for the intent's lifetime, and the intent stops when cancelled, expired or fully spent. Agent wallets offer a parallel route with onchain-enforced spend caps, allowed counterparties, time windows and revocation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), broader card eligibility (Visa excludes non-US, business, prepaid, Chase and Fidelity cards), and the fallback rail hands over the real card encrypted rather than a network-scoped token.
